_comment: One credential reaches BOTH flights and hotels: the card-backed token from the connect flow (LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN) or a Developer API key (LETSFG_API_KEY). Connect through the hosted MCP at https://letsfg.co/developers/api/mcp: the consent step opens letsfg.co/connect, where a card is saved in a 0.00 Revolut setup (nothing charged). The token you get is card-backed and can book. Hotels use the same card. If both vars are set the Bearer token is used.

env.LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN: YOUR_CARD_BACKED_TOKEN_HERE (from the connect flow) — or use LETSFG_API_KEY
